missing-goal.title: Some goal details are still open
missing-goal.description: You have not provided both a target amount and a date. Keeping these unknown is fine; clarifying them is a useful next step before comparing options.
missing-goal.reason: A clearer amount and date will help you ask more specific planning questions.

unanswered.title: Some constraints are not provided
unanswered.description: Unanswered profile questions are not evidence that you can absorb losses or leave money invested. You can return to them when you know more.
unanswered.reason: Write down what a loss or an early need for money would mean for this goal.

early-access.title: You may need access earlier
early-access.description: You said some money could be needed before the goal date. Withdrawal conditions and money earmarked for other needs are worth checking separately from possible growth.
early-access.reason: Check how quickly you could withdraw money and whether restrictions or penalties apply.

capacity-tension.title: Comfort and capacity may differ
capacity-tension.description: You are comfortable with fluctuations, but a loss could affect essential needs or delay your goal. Willingness to take risk does not remove that constraint.
capacity-tension.reason: Explore the difference between accepting uncertainty emotionally and being able to absorb a loss.

timing-tension.title: Your goal date is close
timing-tension.description: You are comfortable with fluctuations, but expect to need the money in less than two years. A fall near that date could matter even if you are comfortable with uncertainty.
timing-tension.reason: Consider what a fall just before your goal date would mean, without assuming time guarantees a recovery.

not-sure.title: You have identified an uncertainty
not-sure.description: You answered Not sure to at least one question. That identifies something to explore; it is not a low-risk or high-risk classification.
not-sure.reason: Use a lesson or a written question to explore what you are not sure about.

starting-knowledge.title: Build understanding one concept at a time
starting-knowledge.description: You described yourself as starting out. This is self-reported familiarity, not a measure of mastery or a reason to rush a financial decision.
starting-knowledge.reason: Practise finding reliable information and note the terms you would like explained.

past-goal.title: Your saved goal date has passed
past-goal.description: Your goal is still here. Review whether its date, purpose, or access needs have changed; the app has not assumed that the goal was achieved.
past-goal.reason: Revisit a goal whose saved date is now in the past.

review-note.title: You have questions to revisit
review-note.description: Your written questions can guide your next learning or research step. The app does not analyse this note or infer recommendations from its contents.
review-note.reason: Set aside time to revisit the questions you recorded.
